tasks.description: Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C) to ensure proper baking temperature. This step is crucial for the banana bread to turn out moist and delicious. The oven should be preheated before starting to mix the ingredients.
acceptance_criteria: Given the oven is preheated, when a thermometer is inserted, then the temperature reads 350°F (175°C).

tasks.description: Grease a 9x5 loaf pan to prevent the banana bread from sticking to it. This step is necessary for easy removal of the bread after baking.
acceptance_criteria: Given the loaf pan is greased, when the banana bread is baked and removed, then it does not stick to the pan.

tasks.description: Mash 3 ripe bananas with a fork until smooth to create the base for the banana bread. Overripe, spotty bananas give the best flavor.
acceptance_criteria: Given the bananas are mashed, when they are inspected, then they are smooth and free of lumps.

tasks.description: Stir the melted butter into the mashed bananas to combine the ingredients. This step is essential for the flavor and texture of the banana bread.
acceptance_criteria: Given the butter and bananas are mixed, when the mixture is inspected, then it is well combined.

tasks.description: Mix in the baking soda and salt to add flavor and texture to the banana bread. These ingredients are crucial for the bread to rise and have the right flavor.
acceptance_criteria: Given the baking soda and salt are added, when the mixture is inspected, then they are well combined with the other ingredients.

tasks.description: Stir in the sugar, beaten egg, and vanilla extract to add sweetness and flavor to the banana bread. These ingredients are essential for the bread to have the right taste and texture.
acceptance_criteria: Given the sugar, egg, and vanilla are added, when the mixture is inspected, then they are well combined with the other ingredients.

tasks.description: Fold in the flour until just combined to create the final batter for the banana bread. It is essential not to overmix the batter at this stage.
acceptance_criteria: Given the flour is folded in, when the batter is inspected, then it is just combined and not overmixed.

tasks.description: Pour the batter into the prepared loaf pan to bake the banana bread. This step is necessary for the bread to have the right shape and texture.
acceptance_criteria: Given the batter is poured into the loaf pan, when the pan is inspected, then it is filled to the correct level.

tasks.description: Bake the banana bread for 50 to 60 minutes, until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. This step is crucial for the bread to be fully cooked and delicious.
acceptance_criteria: Given the banana bread is baked, when a toothpick is inserted into the center, then it comes out clean.
